rationale: The reporter's template label is bug and the report describes uv behaving contrary to its intended design: uv correctly refuses to select a per-file yanked wheel for install but still writes that wheel's URL and hash into uv.lock's wheels array. The reporter traces this to PrioritizedDist::built_dist() and WheelCompatibility::is_excluded(), which only matches ExcludeNewer and not Yanked, and shows the stale entry survives --locked and --frozen. The report includes versions (uv 0.12.4), platform, a step-by-step reproduction on a devpi index, and symmetric results when the yanked file is swapped, so it is actionable without an extra MRE. The uv resolution docs read did not document yank-based exclusion from the lockfile, so I did not treat this as a config or docs issue. search_issues returned only an unrelated 2023 issue (#592, environment variable expansion), so no duplicate was found. Index-side per-file yanking is a PEP 592 feature, but the defect sits in uv's lock writer, so this is not external.
